name: Split autotabs (text | image slider, tabs below)
purpose: Presents 4-5 platform pillars or service stages as a tabbed slider of text-plus-image slides under a configurable header, optionally closed by a big customer quote and CTA.
description: Page-local block (/lms/corporate-lms once, /lms/enterprise twice). A header slot (H2 alone; H2 | grey intro with an inline link; or eyebrow + H2 | italic quote card with avatar) sits above a loop slider whose slides are split 47%/47%: a 20px title, grey paragraph and optional arrow text-link on the left, a square/1440:1289 product image on the right (stacked <=767). The tab row sits BELOW the slider (equal 4.75rem tabs; <=767 two per row, 3.5rem). An optional closing node follows the slider: on the enterprise services instance a big centred 32px quote with stacked avatar and a centred primary button.
